title: ABILITY (Yetenek)
usageNote: COULD geçmişte GENEL bir yeteneği anlatır; WAS/WERE ABLE TO ve MANAGED TO ise uzun uğraşlar sonucu özel bir işi başarmayı anlatır.

entries.exampleSentence: Modern computers can process vast amounts of data in seconds.
She is able to speak three languages fluently.
When I was a child, I could climb trees without any fear.
Despite the storm, we were able to finish building the shelter before nightfall.
Despite the technical difficulties, engineers managed to launch the satellite successfully.
With advanced technology, historians will be able to uncover more ancient mysteries.

title: POSSIBILITY (Olasılık)
usageNote: Şimdiki/gelecek olasılık bildirir. COULD burada hem geçmiş yeteneği hem şimdiki olasılığı anlatabilir.

entries.exampleSentence: The sudden collapse of the Maya civilization may indicate severe environmental pressures.
Strange bioluminescent creatures discovered in the deepest ocean layers might represent unknown species.
Ancient inscriptions discovered on remote cave walls could belong to an unknown language.
Given his extensive experience and impressive portfolio, he is likely to secure the job offer.
Historians now find it less likely to uncover new evidence about ancient civilizations.

title: ADVICE (Tavsiye)
usageNote: SHOULD/OUGHT TO tavsiye verir; HAD BETTER alttan alta tehdit içerir; MUST güçlü bir tavsiyedir.

entries.exampleSentence: Scientists should wear gloves when handling chemicals in a lab.
To improve mental health, people ought to talk openly about their feelings.
You had better check the weather before you leave, as it looks like it might rain.
You must take regular breaks while studying to avoid burnout.
Employees must wear safety helmets on the construction site.
To maintain your driver's license, you have to renew it every five years.
If you want to grab the themes in the novel, you have got to read the introduction carefully.
Developed nations need to prioritize renewable energy sources.
While studying the history of ancient Rome, you don't have to read every single document.
He doesn't need to bring his own tools for the workshop.
Individuals with mild anxiety needn't necessarily seek professional help.
Thanks to the invention of the printing press, scholars didn't have to hand-copy manuscripts anymore.
Since we finished the project early, we didn't need to stay late at the office.
You can't use your phone during the exam; it's against the rules.
Visitors mustn't touch the exhibits in the museum.
Employees are not allowed to access the restricted areas of the building.
Given the amount of experience he has, he must be one of the top experts in his field.
They can't be at home; all the lights are off and the curtains are closed.
Since the door is locked, the workers mustn't be at the office yet.
Can you please pass me the salt?
Could you help me with this report when you have a moment?
Will you please turn down the music? It's a bit too loud.
Would you help me understand this topic better?
Would you mind opening the door, please?
May I leave the office early today to attend a family event?
Might I take a break now? I'm tired of studying.
Can I use your laptop for the presentation if you need it?
Could I possibly use your phone for a quick call?

title: EXPECTATION (Beklenti)
usageNote: BE SUPPOSED TO/BE TO üç şekilde çevrilebilir: başlaması bekleniyor / başlayacak / başlaması gerekiyor.

entries.exampleSentence: The event is supposed to start at 7 PM, so we should be there a bit earlier.
In many cultures, teenagers are to demonstrate respect for their elders.
The new policy is due to take effect next week.

title: HABITUAL ACTIVITIES (Geçmiş Alışkanlık)
usageNote: USED TO hem hareket hem durum bildiren fiillerle kullanılır; WOULD sadece hareket bildiren fiillerle kullanılır.

entries.exampleSentence: Before the internet became so widespread, people used to rely on libraries and bookstores.
In old Arctic villages, people would gather at night to tell mystical stories.
He didn't use to travel for work frequently, but now his job requires it every month.

title: BE/GET USED TO (Alışkanlık Olma)
usageNote: BE USED TO zaten alışkın olmayı, GET USED TO ise alışma sürecini anlatır. Fiilden sonra Ving gelir.

entries.exampleSentence: He is used to running every morning.
She is accustomed to studying late at night, so she finds it hard to focus in the morning.
She is getting used to exercising every morning, and it's becoming part of her routine.
As I travel more, I'm getting accustomed to stepping outside of my comfort zone.

title: PREFERENCE (Tercih)
usageNote: WOULD RATHER/WOULD SOONER arkasından V1 alır; WOULD PREFER arkasından TO V1 alır; PREFER karşılaştırmada TO alır.

entries.exampleSentence: She would rather read a book than watch TV.
I would sooner listen to music than watch a movie tonight.

entries.term: would prefer to V1 (rather than V1)
entries.exampleSentence: They would prefer to eat at the new restaurant rather than the one we usually go to.
She prefers cooking at home to dining out.
I would rather you called me before making a decision.
She would prefer him to drive carefully on the snowy roads.

title: KONUŞMA ANINA GÖNDERME (Modal + be Ving)
usageNote: Konuşma anında devam eden bir eylem hakkında tahmin/tavsiye yapılırken modal + be Ving kalıbı kullanılır.

entries.exampleSentence: She must be studying for her exams since she's been in the library all day.
The patient can't be making significant progress if they aren't actively participating in therapy.
The artifacts found at the site may be revealing new insights into ancient civilizations.
We should be reducing our plastic use if we want to protect the environment.
The sudden changes in behavior could be indicating an underlying psychological issue.

title: WOULD'UN DİĞER KULLANIMLARI
usageNote: WOULD; geçmiş alışkanlık dışında, if cümlelerinde farazi durumları ve geçmişten geleceğe bakışı da anlatabilir.

entries.exampleSentence: If archaeologists found a hidden library in ancient ruins, it would revolutionize our knowledge of early civilizations.
Early scientists believed that the printing press would forever change societies.

title: PERFECT MODALS (MODAL + HAVE V3)
usageNote: Bir modalı geçmiş anlamda kullanmak için modalın arkasına "have V3" eklenir. Her modal farklı bir geçmiş yorumu (tavsiyeye uyulmaması, ihtimal, kesin çıkarım vb.) taşır.

entries.exampleSentence: The researchers should have conducted more experiments before publishing the results.
The company shouldn't have ignored the environmental issue.
The researchers may have overlooked some important data.
The teacher might have misunderstood the question.
The explorers could have taken the wrong path, resulting in their failure to reach the summit.
I could have gone directly to university, but I decided to travel for a year.
The ancient civilization can't have survived without advanced knowledge of agriculture.
The dinosaurs must have lived in large groups to protect themselves from predators.
The ancient people mustn't have known the consequences of deforestation.
The king needn't have worried about the attack, as the enemy had already surrendered.
If the ancient scripts had been preserved, historians would have gained deeper insights into lost civilizations.
